extension.description: Browse and play audiobooks and podcasts from your AudioBookShelf server.
extension.news: v0.23.0 Browsing overhaul. The sort menu actually works now — Kodi was silently re-sorting the server-sorted page alphabetically. The picker moved to the context menu and there are more sorts. In-progress items carry a real resume point instead of "[42%]" in the title, so skins draw their own progress indicator and Kodi offers Resume. Every folder has an icon. Narrator, duration, genre and year moved into the info tag. Missing covers show a placeholder. Added fan art. Removed the unsupported Music player option.
